paragraphs: Yochanan, scribe of Rabban Gamliel [the Elder].

Sanhedrin 11b relates that Rabban Gamliel was sitting on a step on the Temple Mount, with Yochanan the scribe standing before him: “Take one letter and write,” etc. Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:4 reads Yochanan the Priest, the scribe.

notes.text: The Elder is bracketed in the supplied heading. The Jerusalem Talmud reading adds the Priest to Yochanan’s designation.
